requirements: Automation Test Engineer for payments platforms. Krakow/Warsaw hybrid work 6x/month. Build and maintain Java-based automated test frameworks and suites across UI, API and integration layers. Translate payment requirements into automated test cases covering end-to-end flows and edge cases. Automate payment types/components such as credit transfers, direct debits, SWIFT/ISO 20022 messages, payment gateways, validation, routing and posting. Create REST/SOAP API and service-level automation, including contract/schema validation where relevant. Validate cut-off times, value dates, charges/fees, FX if applicable, limits, sanctions/AML screening touchpoints, returns/recalls, reversals, rejects/repairs and exception handling. Implement test data strategy for payments, synthetic data/masking/data seeding and transaction correlation across systems. Integrate tests into CI/CD with unattended execution, reporting and quality gates. Analyze failures using logs, message traces and database queries. Collaborate with POs, Developers, BAs and Ops on acceptance criteria, test approach and release readiness. Maintain automation coverage, traceability and execution dashboards/metrics. Key skills: Java clean code/OOP/design patterns, JUnit/TestNG, optional Cucumber/BDD, Selenium/Playwright, REST Assured, Postman/Newman, SoapUI, Maven/Gradle, Git, Jenkins/GitLab CI/Azure DevOps, flakiness reduction, parallel execution, environment resilience, logs/tracing/monitoring such as Splunk/ELK, SQL, payment lifecycle, ISO 20022, SWIFT MT/MX, auditability and resiliency.
